# Bot Proactive Monitor
On every invocation: npm run smoke && npm run audit:static. If exit != 0 report REG ids. Grep footguns: bare composer.list(, accessibleGuilds, pollMinutes n < 2, health uptime without uptimeMs. Never claim production healthy without smoke pass.
